title: A. Most 2-week passes: one winner passes, room 100%, weekly stop on, x2 from session 6
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: an MFFU 50K eval must be passed within 10 sessions; maximise P(pass in 10) and minimise $91.80 / P(pass in 10).
verdict: The most 2-week passes in both halves (min of the 4 samples 52.9%), but 18-29% of evals fail within 2 weeks. 50K: H1 starts (pick) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 58.8/17.6/23.6% (n 119), within 20 73.4/25.7%, cost per 2-week pass $156.0, worst day $-1,011, max at risk $1,000; H2 starts (check) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 56.5/29.0/14.5% (n 69), within 20 52.5/47.5%, cost per 2-week pass $162.0, worst day $-1,009, max at risk $996; 2026 pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 55.3/23.9/20.8% (n 197), within 20 59.9/39.6%, cost per 2-week pass $166.0, worst day $-1,011, max at risk $1,000; Monte Carlo 4,000 x 20 sessions (5-session blocks): H1 52.9/21.5/25.6, H2 56.6/23.7/19.7; 2021-25 reference (5m) 19.6/33.3. Back to back (new eval after a pass, a fail or 10 sessions): 2026 18 passes in 31 evals ($158 a pass), 2021-25 27 in 137 ($466). 25K ($63, every $ halved): H1 54.6/19.3, H2 53.6/26.1, cost per 2-week pass H1 $115.0 / H2 $118.0.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
